title: Moved around over carpet in the dressing room. Thin, rubber backing. Better in bathroom.
text:
Moved around over carpet in the dressing room. Thin, rubber backing. Better in bathroom.. In Update. This is not wearing well, and it’s cheesy.
———————-
Since this was advertised as a hallway runner I thought it would work well In my dressing room over the carpet in front of the sinks!
This has a nonskid rubber backing.
This carpet is thin with a ribbed pattern, and it moves around on the carpet.
My shower and toilet are in a separate room and it works better in there, not over carpet
Although I have another thicker carpet in my dressing room that did not move around like this one does.
This would work better in a bathroom with tile or vinyl floors.

This is not a thick throw carpet.
